content.prompt: A cube of side length 3 cm is made from 27 cubes with sides of length 1 cm. Three cubes are removed so that there is a hole from one face to the opposite face. What is the surface area of the resulting object?

answer.short:
$64\text{ cm}^2$

An enclosed through-hole exposes four internal walls.
answer.worked:
The original surface area is $6\times3^2=54\text{ cm}^2$. The through-hole removes a $1\text{ cm}^2$ opening from each of two opposite faces and exposes four internal walls, each $3\text{ cm}\times1\text{ cm}$.

$S=54-2(1)+4(3)=64\text{ cm}^2$.
